# OPTIMAL PC SELECTION ALGO
```{r quick-elbow}
quick.elbow <- function(varpc,low=.08,max.pc=.9) {
  ee <- varpc/sum(varpc) #proportinal eigenvalues
  while(low>=max(ee)) { low <- low/2 } #when no principal component eigenvalues are large enough, cut low in half
  lowie <- (ee<low) ; highie <- ee>low/8
  low.ones <- which(lowie & highie)
  others <- length(which(!lowie))
  if(length(low.ones)>0) {
    if(length(low.ones)==1) {
      elbow <- low.ones
    } else {
      set <- ee[low.ones]
      pc.drops <- abs(diff(set))/(set[1:(length(set)-1)])
      infz <- is.infinite(pc.drops)
      #print(pc.drops)
      elbow <- which(pc.drops==max(pc.drops[!infz],na.rm=T))[1]+others
    }
  } else {
    # if somehow there are no small eigenvalues, just choose the elbow as the second last
    cat("no eigenvalues were significantly smaller than the previous\n")
    elbow <- length(ee)
  }
  if(tail(cumsum(ee[1:elbow]),1)>max.pc) {
    elbow <- which(cumsum(ee)>max.pc)[1]-1
  }
  if(elbow<1) {
    warning("elbow calculation failed, return zero")
    return(0)
  }
  elbow<-elbow + 1 # include last to be sure ..
  names(elbow) <- NULL
  return(elbow)
}
```

# GENES FILTERING
```{r gene-filter}
genes_filter <- function(df, filters = c("IgFilter", "TrFilter", "riboFilter", "mtFilter", "gmFilter", "rikFilter", "dotFilter")) {
  #ensure gene names are uppercase for consistent matching
  geneNames <- toupper(rownames(df))
  GenesToFilterOut <- integer(0)
  if(is.null(filters)){
    return(df)
  }

  #immunoglobulin genes (IGHV, IGKV)
  if ("IgFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_starts(geneNames, "IGHV") | str_starts(geneNames, "IGKV"))
    )
  }

  #t-cell receptor genes (TRAV, TRBV)
  if ("TrFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_starts(geneNames, "TRAV") | str_starts(geneNames, "TRBV"))
    )
  }

  #ribosomal genes (RPL, RPS)
  if ("riboFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_starts(geneNames, "RPL") | str_starts(geneNames, "RPS"))
    )
  }

  #mitochondrial genes (MT-)
  if ("mtFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_starts(geneNames, "MT-"))
    )
  }

  #GM-prefixed genes
  if ("gmFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_starts(geneNames, "GM"))
    )
  }

  #genes ending with RIK
  if ("rikFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(str_ends(geneNames, "RIK"))
    )
  }

  #genes starting with "\\.", ENSG, or a regex pattern like XX000000
  if ("dotFilter" %in% filters) {
    GenesToFilterOut <- c(
      GenesToFilterOut,
      which(
        str_starts(geneNames, "\\.") |
        str_starts(geneNames, "ENSG") |
        str_detect(geneNames, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d{6}")
      )
    )
  }

  #remove duplicate indices
  GenesToFilterOut <- unique(GenesToFilterOut)

  #return filtered dataframe
  if (length(GenesToFilterOut) > 0) {
    filtered_df <- df[-GenesToFilterOut, , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    filtered_df <- df  # No genes to filter, return original
  }

  list(
    counts=filtered_df,
    filtered=setdiff(rownames(df), rownames(filtered_df))
  )
}
```

# PRINCIPAL GENES ALGO
```{r principal-genes-algo}
principalgenes <- function(count_matrix, pcs, filters) {
  data <- genes_filter(count_matrix, filters)$counts
  repeat {                                    # drop zero cells / zero-variance genes until stable
    zc <- which(colSums(data) == 0); if (length(zc)) data <- data[, -zc]
    zr <- which(apply(data, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) == 0); if (length(zr)) data <- data[-zr, ]
    if (!length(zc) && !length(zr)) break
  }
  pca <- prcomp_irlba(t(data), n = pcs, retx = TRUE, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  loadings <- abs(pca$rotation); rownames(loadings) <- rownames(data)
  prop_var <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  percent_cont <- sweep(loadings, 2, colSums(loadings), "/")
  tot_contr <- rowSums(sweep(percent_cont, 2, prop_var, "*"))
  if (any(!is.finite(tot_contr))) stop("Contribution calculation produced NA/Inf values.")
  list(top_genes = sort(tot_contr, decreasing = TRUE), count_matrix = data)
}
```

# Helpers
```{r helpers}
# Save a plot as both LZW TIFF and JPEG (file_stub = path without extension)
save_plot_both <- function(plot, file_stub, width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# Clustering sensitivity of the top TOP_N principal genes for each number of PCs
run_varpcs <- function(cfg) {
  count_matrix <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, cfg$counts), row.names = 1)
  rownames(count_matrix) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(count_matrix))
  colnames(count_matrix) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(count_matrix))

  truth <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, cfg$labels))
  truth$cell <- gsub("\\.", "-", truth$cell)

  base  <- principalgenes(count_matrix, pcs = 2, filters = FILTERS)
  truth <- truth[match(colnames(base$count_matrix), truth$cell), ]
  true_labels_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(factor(truth$label, levels = unique(truth$label))), truth$cell)
  k_cls <- max(true_labels_vector)

  acc <- numeric(length(N_PCS))
  for (i in seq_along(N_PCS)) {
    set.seed(SEED)
    pg <- principalgenes(count_matrix, pcs = N_PCS[i], filters = FILTERS)
    submat <- pg$count_matrix[names(pg$top_genes)[1:TOP_N], ]
    clusters <- skmeans(t(log2(submat + 1)), k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    acc[i] <- as.numeric(clustSensitivity(clusters, true_labels_vector, as.character(1:k_cls))[1, 2])
    message("PCs = ", N_PCS[i], " -> accuracy = ", round(acc[i], 3))
  }

  data.frame(n_pcs = N_PCS, accuracy = acc)
}

make_varpcs_plot <- function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(n_pcs, accuracy)) +
    geom_point(colour = "orange", size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, colour = "blue") +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(x = "Principal Component n", y = "Clustering Sensitivity") +
    theme_gray(base_size = 10, base_family = FONT_FAMILY)
}
```

# Run all datasets
```{r run-all}
for (name in names(DATASETS)) {
  message("==================== ", name, " ====================")
  df <- run_varpcs(DATASETS[[name]])
  p  <- make_varpcs_plot(df)
  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(name, "_accuracy_vs_nPCs")))
}
```
